codex._note: Self-building launcher. As an installed plugin, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves to the plugin cache dir; in this repo it is left unset and the launcher falls back to the project root. dist/ is gitignored, so a freshly cloned plugin has no build — the launcher installs deps and builds on first start instead of exiting with -32000. Dev note: an existing dist/ is never rebuilt automatically; run `npm run build` after editing src/.
args: cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" 2>/dev/null || cd "$PWD" || exit 1; [ -d node_modules ] || npm install --no-audit --no-fund 1>&2; [ -f dist/index.js ] || npm run build 1>&2; exec node dist/index.js
